{{Current events|year=2026|month=02|day=24|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Nuclear risk during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Nuclear risk during the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***The [[Foreign Intelligence Service (Russia)|Foreign Intelligence Service]] of [[Russia]] accuses [[France]] and the [[United Kingdom]] of preparing to supply [[Ukraine]] with a [[nuclear weapon]], prompting the [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Russia)|Russian foreign ministry]] to warn that such a move would lead to a direct conflict between [[NATO]] states and Russia. [https://www.trtworld.com/article/7210ec0375a5 (TRT World)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-issues-statement-warning-risks-clash-between-nuclear-powers-2026-02-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Myanmar Civil War (2021–present)|Myanmar Civil War]]
**[[Conflict in Rakhine State (2016–present)|Conflict in Rakhine State]]
***The [[Myanmar Air Force]] [[airstrike]]s on suspected rebel targets kill at least 17 in the [[Rakhine state]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/2/25/military-government-air-strikes-kill-17-in-western-myanmar-state (Al Jazeera)]
*[[M23 campaign (2022–present)|M23 campaign]]
**The governor of [[South Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], reports the discovery of two [[mass grave]]s containing at least 172 bodies in [[Uvira]], South Kivu, following the withdrawal of the [[March 23 Movement]] (M23) from the city. Rights groups previously reported alleged killings during the M23's presence. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/mass-graves-found-eastern-congo-after-rebel-withdrawal-governor-says-2026-02-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Syrian conflict (2024–present)|Syrian conflict]]
**Three [[Saraya al-Jawad]] gunmen and a soldier are killed in a [[shootout]] in [[Latakia]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/2/25/syria-faces-twin-battles-as-assad-loyalists-and-isil-attack-in-west-east (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Five [[Law enforcement in Pakistan|police officers]] are killed by the [[Pakistani Taliban]] during two [[ambush]]es in [[Kohat District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-militant-attacks-police-northwest-0d9adcf70f40215d1153b73016642ca7 (AP)]
**Four police officers are killed and three civilians injured in a suicide bombing at a checkpoint in [[Bhakkar District]], [[Punjab, Pakistan|Punjab]], Pakistan. [https://english.news.cn/20260225/00dac217eb9e4b4ca95659ade610bc1b/c.html (Xinhua)]
*[[Terrorism in Russia]]
**Two people are killed, including the suspect, and two others are injured in a [[Suicide attack|suicide bombing]] targeting a police car near the [[Moscow Savyolovsky railway station|Savyolovsky railway station]] in [[Moscow]], [[Russia]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2634181/world (AFP via ''Arab News'')] [https://english.news.cn/20260224/f3ebd1bdb30b411fae527d0942c6f7ea/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[AI boom]], [[2024–present global memory supply shortage]]
**American technology company [[Meta Platforms|Meta]] agrees to purchase millions of [[artificial intelligence]] chips from [[AMD]], with AMD committing to supply up to six gigawatts of [[graphics processing unit]]s and issuing Meta warrants convertible into 160 million [[Share (finance)|shares]] as part of a long-term partnership. [https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/24/02/2026/meta-amd-agree-to-major-chips-deal (AFP via ''The Peninsula Qatar'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Thirty people are killed, 39 others are reported missing and at least 440 are [[Internally displaced person|displaced]] from their homes after [[Rain|heavy rain]] triggers [[flash flood]]ing in [[Juiz de Fora]], [[Minas Gerais]], [[Brazil]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260224-torrential-rains-leave-23-dead-in-brazil-dozens-missing (AFP via France 24)] [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/least-14-dead-after-heavy-rains-hit-southeastern-brazil-2026-02-24/ (Reuters)]
*Four people are killed and several others are injured when an [[Islamic Republic of Iran Army Aviation]] [[Bell AH-1 SuperCobra]] helicopter crashes into a fruit market in [[Dorcheh, Isfahan|Dorcheh]], [[Isfahan province]], [[Iran]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iranian-military-helicopter-crashes-into-fruit-market-four-dead-2026-02-24 (Reuters)] [https://www.jfeed.com/news-world/iran-helicopter-crash-isfahan (JFeed)]
*At least four people are killed and nine others are injured in an explosion at a house in [[Antonio Ante Canton]], [[Imbabura Province]], [[Ecuador]]. [https://english.news.cn/20260225/ed7feb4aa2c74d4c93ac27476cd411a0/c.html (Xinhua)]
*Four people are killed and another is critically injured from [[carbon monoxide poisoning]] at an apartment building in [[Kursk Oblast]], [[Russia]]. [https://english.news.cn/20260225/98f725a9237c49c8bd65c4adfc4de1eb/c.html (Xinhua)]
*The death toll from an explosion and fire at a six-story residential building in [[Chattogram]], [[Bangladesh]], rises to three. [https://news.az/news/death-toll-rises-to-3-in-southeast-bangladesh-gas-blast (News.Az)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Bolivia–United States relations]]
**[[Bolivia]] resumes operational cooperation with the [[United States]] [[Drug Enforcement Administration]] (DEA) to combat [[Illegal drug trade|drug trafficking]] and [[organized crime]] after a 17-year suspension. Bolivia says the renewed collaboration will include efforts to address [[money laundering]] linked to the [[Narcotics in Bolivia|illicit drug trade]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/bolivia-restores-us-dea-ties-after-17-years-push-against-drug-trafficking-2026-02-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Guinea–Sierra Leone relations]]
**[[Sierra Leone]] says that [[Guinea]] has detained several of [[Republic of Sierra Leone Armed Forces|its army]] and [[Sierra Leone Police|police]] personnel and seized their ammunition during construction work on [[Guinea–Sierra Leone border|border]] facilities in [[Sulima Chiefdom]], [[Falaba District]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/sierra-leone-says-members-its-security-forces-held-by-guinea-border-row-2026-02-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Hungary–Ukraine relations]]
**[[Prime Minister of Hungary|Hungarian prime minister]] [[Viktor Orbán]] announces that [[Hungary]] has ended all support for [[Ukraine]], including through [[European Union]] framework, until Ukraine resumes [[Fuel oil|oil]] transfers via the [[Druzhba pipeline]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/hungarys-premier-says-due-to-druzhba-oil-dispute-he-cant-back-eu-decisions-to-help-ukraine/3838779 (AA)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*{{ill|Denisse Miralles|es}} is sworn in as the new [[Prime Minister of Peru]], succeeding [[Ernesto Álvarez Miranda]]. [https://andina.pe/agencia/noticia-peru-denisse-miralles-sworn-in-new-prime-minister-1064350.aspx (''Andina'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*The [[United Kingdom]]'s [[Information Commissioner's Office]] (ICO) [[Fine (penalty)|fines]] American [[social media]] network [[Reddit]] [[Pound sterling|£]]14.5m for "using the data of children under the age of 13 unlawfully", and potentially exposing them to "inappropriate and harmful content", including [[pornography]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/feb/24/reddit-fined-uk-children-under-13-data (''The Guardian'')]
